description: This file defines the RandomErrorInjector class used for injecting random faults during transaction testing, including custom exception classes for fault simulation.

classes.name: RandomErrorInjector
classes.description: A class that injects random faults into transaction processes based on specified probabilities.

classes.name: RandomlyInjectedStorageException
classes.description: A custom exception class representing injected storage faults.

classes.name: RandomlyInjectedInconsistentStateException
classes.description: A custom exception class representing injected inconsistent state faults.

methods.name: RandomErrorInjector
methods.description: Constructor that initializes fault probabilities based on injection probability.

methods.name: BeforeStore
methods.description: Method that randomly throws exceptions before storing, simulating faults.

methods.name: AfterStore
methods.description: Method that randomly throws exceptions after storing, simulating faults.

methods.description: Constructor for the storage exception class.
